# Vendor

`vendor/bitwarden-clients` contains the official Bitwarden clients repository pinned to:

```text
f47b6946e01aed474875789081966d311d5b8289
```

Restore command:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/bitwarden/clients.git vendor/bitwarden-clients
git -C vendor/bitwarden-clients checkout f47b6946e01aed474875789081966d311d5b8289
```
